_about: Phase F0 register probes (authored 2026-10-15, BEFORE any static-embedding measurement). Nigerian lay English and Pidgin, each with ONE corpus-verified expected Act clause (read from data/processed/act2018_v2_clauses.json in the same session). REPORT-ONLY: never gates, never selects a parameter. It exists because no harness has ever been scored on Pidgin. Expected refs are Act-only on purpose: the factsheet mirrors Act numbering, but only the Act text was verified here.

probes.text: Dem fit sack me for work because say I dey use wheelchair?
Government office suppose employ people wey get disability?
Hospital no wan treat my brother wey get mental problem unless we pay money
probes.note: cl.21(2) free medical service for mental disability

probes.text: My pikin wey deaf, school go dey free for am?
probes.note: cl.17(2) free education to secondary level

probes.text: Dem dey use my blind uncle beg money for roadside, e legal?
probes.note: cl.16(1)(a) involving a PWD in begging

probes.text: Na only stairs for the ministry building, I no fit enter with my crutches
probes.note: cl.3 right of access to buildings

probes.text: Someone who is not disabled keeps parking in the disabled space at the supermarket
For bank queue, dem suppose allow me go front?
The airline staff refused to give me a wheelchair at the airport
Government bus no get ramp, how I go take enter with my chair?
If flood or fighting happen for our area, who go protect disabled people?
I want to run for councillor but people say a cripple cannot hold office
probes.note: cl.30 participation in politics and public life

probes.text: Where I go collect the paper wey show say my sister get mental disability?
What happens to someone who buys a fake disability certificate?
probes.note: cl.23 unlawful procurement, N200,000 or one year

probes.text: I fit sue the person for court even if police no charge am?
Who do I complain to when a public building is not accessible to me?
My papa deaf, hospital no get person wey sabi sign language to talk with am
probes.note: cl.24 special communication at public hospitals

probes.text: How many years did the government have to fix old buildings for disabled people?
The school hostel no gree give my son room because of im disability
probes.note: cl.27 accommodation by schools, employers, providers

probes.text: Do I have to prove how much money I lost before the court will give me damages?
probes.note: cl.55 waiver of proof of special damages
